decisions.reason: As a simple accessory closely tied to the firm's established trailer, spare-parts and service knowledge, it is within its absorptive capacity, though its lower prominence suggests somewhat higher pruning risk than the main trailer lines.

A box car trailer series sits directly in the firm's core trailer competence and was highlighted on the home page in both observed years, so management would likely retain and refine it rather than exit.

A car transporter trailer is still strongly related to the firm's existing production and customer knowledge, but its more niche positioning makes discontinuation somewhat more plausible than for the flagship ranges.
The low-bed trailer series is a clear extension of the firm's core hauling-solutions business and repeated home-page visibility indicates enough strategic importance to keep it on the market.
The high trailer cover series builds on the firm's existing trailer platform knowledge and after-sales capabilities, so the firm is well placed to learn and continue offering it.

This box car trailer series is highly related to the firm's established know-how and was prominently marketed, which under an absorptive-capacity view supports continued commercialization rather than withdrawal.
